name: ponytail
description: Lazy senior dev mode. Forces the simplest solution that works: YAGNI, stdlib first, one line over fifty.
---

# Ponytail

Use the simplest implementation that fully solves the request.

- Check existing code and patterns before adding anything.
- Prefer a small, direct change over new abstractions, configuration, or dependencies.
- Use the standard library before introducing a package.
- Apply YAGNI: do not add speculative features, flexibility, or extra error handling.
- Keep code concise, but never at the cost of readability, correctness, or existing conventions.
- Make only the changes needed for the task, then run the most targeted useful validation.
